# Resource limits at all three levels, and the discoverability that was the real
# complaint: an operator went looking for CPU capping in `breeze --help`, found
# nothing, and wrote a document asserting breeze couldn't limit itself. A limit
# nobody can find is close to a limit that isn't there.
env BREEZE_DIR=$WORK/state

exec breeze register identity admin
cp stdout admin.token

# --- a malformed limit is refused at APPLY, not discovered mid-run ---
! exec breeze apply -f typo.hcl --as admin --token-file admin.token
stderr 'cpu_quota "1400"'
stderr 'percentage'
exec breeze list pipelines
! stdout 'typo'

# --- pipeline-level defaults are inherited per field ---
exec breeze apply -f pipeline.hcl --as admin --token-file admin.token
exec breeze show pipeline capped

# a stage with no block of its own inherits the pipeline default entire
stdout 'build.*\n.*limits: cpu_quota=1400% cpu_weight=50 tasks_max=512'

# a stage that sets some fields keeps those and inherits the rest
stdout 'heavy.*\n.*limits: cpu_quota=2800% cpu_weight=50 memory_max=16G tasks_max=512'

# --- and they're visible in --json too, as the EFFECTIVE set ---
exec breeze show pipeline capped --json
stdout '"cpuWeight":\s*50'

# --- the machine-level floor: applies to every command this daemon runs ---
exec breeze status
stdout 'resource limits \(every command this daemon runs\): \(none\)'

cp defaults.hcl $WORK/state/defaults.hcl
exec breeze restart daemon

exec breeze status
stdout 'resource limits \(every command this daemon runs\): cpu_weight=20 memory_high=2G'

# it also shows up above the stages it silently applies under
exec breeze show pipeline capped
stdout 'machine limits \(this daemon, under every stage below\): cpu_weight=20 memory_high=2G'

# a stage still runs normally under all of it (this asserts the wrapper doesn't
# break execution; on a host without a usable systemd --user session the stage
# fails instead, which is why this only checks that a status came back at all)
exec breeze register identity ci
cp stdout ci.token
exec breeze status stage capped build abc123
stdout 'build'

exec breeze stop

# --- a malformed machine floor stops the daemon rather than silently running
# every command unlimited: the file exists precisely because someone decided
# unbounded commands could hurt this machine.
cp bad-defaults.hcl $WORK/state/defaults.hcl
! exec breeze status
stderr 'cpu_quota|defaults.hcl|did not start'

-- pipeline.hcl --
pipeline "capped" {
  resource_limits {
    cpu_quota = "1400%"
    cpu_weight = 50
    tasks_max = 512
  }

  stage "build" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "1m"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
  }
  stage "heavy" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "1m"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
    resource_limits {
      cpu_quota  = "2800%"
      memory_max = "16G"
    }
  }
}

-- typo.hcl --
pipeline "typo" {
  stage "build" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "1m"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
    resource_limits {
      cpu_quota = "1400"
    }
  }
}

-- defaults.hcl --
resource_limits {
  cpu_weight  = 20
  memory_high = "2G"
}

-- bad-defaults.hcl --
resource_limits {
  cpu_quota = "not-a-percentage"
}
